title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the high-tech breakout rooms of the Academic Innovation Center to the quiet stacks of the Krupp Library, Bryant University offers a range of environments tailored for collaborative projects and deep focus.

cards.title: Quiet Zone (Second Floor)
cards.subtitle: Krupp Library Upper Level
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for a strictly quiet environment. Secluded tables are tucked between bookshelves for maximum focus.
cards.short_summary: The upper level of the Krupp Library is designated for silent, individual study with minimal distractions.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's second floor is the best place for those who need silence, featuring space on couches and between bookshelves.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spots at Bryant - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:30 AM Monday through Thursday during the semester.

cards.title: AIC Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Glass-Walled Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms for group work. They feature floor-to-ceiling whiteboard walls and wireless projection screens.
cards.short_summary: High-tech breakout rooms in the AIC designed for collaborative group projects and design thinking.
cards.evidence_claim: The AIC contains 24 study and breakout rooms available for student work, many with digital displays and whiteboard walls.
cards.source_title: Academic Innovation Center – Center for Teaching Excellence
cards.access_notes: Rooms can be reserved by students for up to 3 hours via LibCal.

cards.title: Janikies Innovation Forum
cards.subtitle: Flexible Open Study Hub
cards.notes: Use this reconfigurable space for casual group study. The furniture and whiteboards can be moved to fit your needs.
cards.short_summary: A highly flexible, open-concept space in the heart of the AIC used for collaborative learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Janikies Innovation Forum is a highly flexible space whose furnishings and whiteboards can be reconfigured.
cards.source_title: Quinlan/Brown Academic Innovation Center | Bryant University Buildings
cards.access_notes: Open access for students when not reserved for official university events.

cards.title: Unistructure Hallway Nooks
cards.subtitle: Quiet Corridor Seating
cards.notes: Look for the corner chair areas in the halls. These spots offer a low-distraction environment away from the main hubs.
cards.short_summary: Quiet seating areas located in the corners of the Unistructure hallways, ideal for focused reading.
cards.evidence_claim: Students recommend the corner chair areas in the halls of the Unistructure for a lack of distractions.
cards.source_title: From Fisher to the BELC, Bulldogs reveal their favorite study spots across campus
cards.access_notes: The Unistructure is technically open 24 hours for student access.

cards.title: Fisher Center 3rd Floor
cards.subtitle: Elevated Quiet Study
cards.notes: Climb to the third floor for a quieter alternative to the busy lower levels. Tables include whiteboards for active studying.
cards.short_summary: The third floor of the student center provides a less populated study area with sunset views.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of Fisher is less populated than the second floor and features whiteboards at the tables.
cards.source_title: 5 Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Check closing times daily; usually closes earlier than the library.

cards.title: BELC Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: New Business Hub Study
cards.notes: Book these modern rooms for team meetings. They are located in the new home of the College of Business.
cards.short_summary: Modern study rooms located in the BELC, designed for business students and group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Students favor the breakout rooms in the BELC, describing them as comfortable and large.
cards.source_title: From Fisher to the BELC, Bulldogs reveal their favorite study spots across campus
cards.access_notes: Reservations are made through the university's LibCal system.

cards.title: ACE Study Labs
cards.subtitle: Supportive Academic Environment
cards.notes: Study in the ACE labs to be near peer tutors and writing consultants. Whiteboards are available for problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: Study labs located within the academic support hub, offering a focused and resource-rich environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Students use ACE's labs for the motivating environment and access to whiteboards.
cards.source_title: From Fisher to the BELC, Bulldogs reveal their favorite study spots across campus
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Unistructure.

cards.title: Stepan Grand Hall
cards.subtitle: Spacious Open Study
cards.notes: When not hosting events, the Grand Hall offers large tables perfect for spreading out textbooks and laptops.
cards.short_summary: A large, impressive hall in the Bello Center that serves as an occasional quiet study area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Heidi and Walter Stepan Grand Hall is used for exhibitions but also provides bare tables for studying when empty.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spots at Bryant - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Subject to availability based on the university's event calendar.

cards.title: Library Main Level Tables
cards.subtitle: Social Study Hub
cards.notes: Choose the first floor for a more social study vibe. It's close to the cafe and perfect for casual group work.
cards.short_summary: The main level of the library offers a collaborative atmosphere near campus resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Students like studying on the first level of the library where the tables are for a less silent environment.
cards.source_title: From Fisher to the BELC, Bulldogs reveal their favorite study spots across campus
cards.access_notes: Features a cafe on the first floor for snacks and coffee.

cards.title: Empty Classrooms (M Wing)
cards.subtitle: After-Hours Group Study
cards.notes: Find an empty classroom in the M wing for late-night group sessions. Use the projectors to practice presentations.
cards.short_summary: Unoccupied classrooms in the Unistructure are popular for group study and presentation prep.
cards.evidence_claim: At night and on weekends, classrooms in the Unistructure are available for team projects and group studying.
cards.source_title: 5 Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Projectors may shut off automatically at 11 PM but can be restarted.
